originalTitle: Why has Brazil accused the US of election interference?
summary: The Latin American country will vote for its next president, as Lula da Silva and Bolsonaro clash over sovereignty, security and ties with Washington.
content:
In Brazil’s upcoming presidential election, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is facing right-wing challenger and ally of Donald Trump, Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

Washington has backed closer ties with Brazil’s right wing, while Lula da Silva has accused Bolsonaro’s camp of encouraging foreign interference.

The election has raised questions about US influence, trade tariffs, organised crime and Brazil’s sovereignty.
chineseTitle: 巴西为何指责美国干预选举？
chineseSummary: 由于卢拉·达席尔瓦和博尔索纳罗在主权、安全以及与华盛顿的关系方面存在冲突，这个拉丁美洲国家将投票选出下一任总统。
chineseContent:
在即将到来的巴西总统选举中，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦将面临右翼挑战者、唐纳德·特朗普的盟友、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

华盛顿支持与巴西右翼建立更密切的关系，而卢拉·达席尔瓦则指责博索纳罗阵营鼓励外国干涉。

此次选举引发了有关美国影响力、贸易关税、有组织犯罪和巴西主权的质疑。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
